title: Which cost ranges have a delete button
stem: Which ranges should show a delete (trash) button while editing?

options.t: Every range except the last, as the PRD says ("The last range ... can't be removed")
Every range except the first, the last one included, as the design draws

context: The PRD gives every range except the last a delete button. The design draws a trash icon on every range except the first, the last "and up" range included.
where: PRD Story 3 (removing a range); Tiered Pricing design canvas, pictures 3.11, 4.6, 4.21
